framework.name: PRINCE2 7
framework.description: PRINCE2 7 method map: 7 processes and their activities cross-referenced to management team roles, practices, management approaches and management products. Role/practice/approach codes: C=Responsible, P=Participates, N=Assists. Product codes: I=Input, O=Output, U=Update, A=Authorise. Activity rows and their codes are a best-effort reconstruction from public sources (prince2.wiki, CC-BY 4.0) and should be SME-verified before formal use.
